name: codex-harness-patterns
description: Long-running task patterns distilled from OpenAI Codex harness v0.149.0 — tool output budgeting, context pressure compaction, parallel sub-agent fan-out, and structured plan streaming. Activates when an agent must manage token budget, decompose work, or sustain multi-step tasks without losing focus. Inspired by codex-rs/core/src/compact.rs, run_turn, and Op/EventMsg protocol.
